reasons.packages/**: Server and web tooling beside the app (the voice web demo, the voice call log worker): no Android code mirrors them
reasons.packages/notify-plugin/**: The server's notify plugin is the callback contract an Android FCM relay would serve, so its changes are reviewed though notifications are skipped
reasons.packages/notify-relay/**: The APNs relay is the model for an FCM relay; review its changes until Android has one
